articles.lead_en: Russia’s Federal Security Service (FSB) will gain round-the-clock access to cryptocurrency exchange customers’ personal data starting in March 2027.

articles.title_en: Russia bombs humanitarian aid distribution site in southern Ukraine, killing 31. More than 40 people remain missing.
articles.lead_en: The Russian military carried out two airstrikes with bombs on Komyshuvakha in the Zaporizhzhia region yesterday, killing 31 people, according to the latest official figures.
